meta.name: skywhale_bazaar
meta.prompt: A desert town built inside the ribcage of a fossilised sky-whale: the ribs form the market hall, the skull is the temple, and the spine is the main street.

programs.brief: A colossal hollowed fossilized sky-whale skull half-buried in the dunes, with vaulted eye sockets and tooth arches forming temple porticos, lit with altar braziers and hanging lanterns.
A towering series of curved fossil sky-whale ribs vaulting high across the street, draped with sun-bleached shade canopies, merchant stalls, and trade counters forming a bone bazaar arcade.
A weathered fossil sky-whale vertebra and spinal segment jutting from the sand dunes as a bleached archway and waypoint marker along the spine road.

tokens.terrain: vast open desert dunes surrounding the colossal fossilised skeleton of a sky-whale half-buried in the sand
tokens.icons: colossal sky-whale fossil skeleton: curved ribcage forming a vaulted market arcade; massive skull hollowed out as a central temple; articulated spine ridge paved as the main street
